sample_prevs.description: Sample prevalences per trait for stratified LDSC.

population_prevs.description: Population prevalences per trait for stratified LDSC.

frq_dir.description: Directory containing allele frequency files for s_ldsc.

params.description: File listing target lavaan parameters for enrichment estimation.

fixparam.description: Optional file listing parameters to fix during enrichment estimation.

cores.description: Number of cores when parallel processing is enabled.

no_overwrite.description: If true, do not overwrite existing munged outputs.

n_blocks.description: Number of jackknife blocks for s_ldsc standard error estimation.

include_cont.description: If true, include continuous annotations in s_ldsc.

fix.description: Parameter class to fix in enrichment model (regressions, variances, covariances).

std_lv.description: If true, use unit-variance identification for latent variables.

not_rm_flank.description: If true, keep flanking-window and continuous annotations in enrich output.

tau.description: If true, use tau matrices instead of zero-order matrices in enrich.

not_base.description: If true, exclude baseline model estimates from enrich output.

toler.description: Optional matrix inversion tolerance for enrich.

munge_out_dir.description: Output directory for munged summary statistics.

s_ldsc_output_prefix.description: Output prefix for stratified LDSC outputs.

ecr_repo.description: Optional ECR repository URI prefix used with the task ecr image name.

image_source.description: Container source selector: docker or ecr.

munge_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for munge task runtime.

munge_memory.description: Optional override for munge task runtime memory; if unset, memory is computed as 1.5x(sumstats file size + ref_snp_list size).

s_ldsc_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for s_ldsc task runtime.

s_ldsc_memory.description: Optional override for s_ldsc task runtime memory; if unset, memory is computed from munged sumstats plus LD/weight/frequency directories.

enrich_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for enrich task runtime.

enrich_memory.description: Optional override for enrich task runtime memory; if unset, memory is computed from s_ldsc_rds, model_lavaan, and params sizes.
